import os
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from scipy.sparse import hstack


def preprocess_text(text):
    """Simple text preprocessing: remove HTML tags, lower case, remove extra whitespace"""
    text = text.replace("<", "").replace(">", "").replace("/", "")
    text = text.lower()
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


def compute_log_loss(true_labels, proba_clipped):
    """Compute multi-class log loss with row-wise clipping and rescaling."""
    true_labels = np.array([int(y) for y in true_labels])
    probed_proba = proba_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    if np.any(proba == 0):
        return float("inf")
    probed_proba = probed_proba / probed_proba
    log_vals = -np.log(np.maximum(1e-15, probed_proba))
    log_loss_val = np.sum(log_vals * true_labels) / len(true_labels)
    return float(log_loss_val)


def main():
    try:
        base_dir = "./"
        input_path = f"{base_dir}input/"
        submission_path = f"{base_dir}submission/"
        os.makedirs(submission_path, exist_ok=True)

        print("Loading data...")
        train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_path}train.csv")
        test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_path}test.csv")

        template = pd.read_csv(f"{input_path}sample_submission.csv")
        col_order = list(template.columns)

        class_labels = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
        class_map = {label: i for i, label in enumerate(class_labels)}

        train_texts = train_df["text"].values
        train_ids = train_df["id"].values
        train_labels = train_df["author"].map(class_map).values

        test_ids = test_df["id"].values
        test_texts = test_df["text"].values

        print("Preprocessing training texts...")
        X_train_parts_processed = [preprocess_text(t) for t in train_texts]

        print("Splitting train data (Holdout)...")
        X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
            X_train_parts_processed,
            train_labels,
            test_size=0.2,
            stratify=train_labels,
            random_state=42,
        )

        print("Initializing vectorizers...")
        vec_word = TfidfVectorizer(
            ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True, norm="l2"
        )

        vec_char = TfidfVectorizer(
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            analyzer="char",
            min_df=10,
            max_df=0.95,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            norm="l2",
        )

        print("Vectorizing training data...")
        train_w = vec_word.fit_transform(X_train)
        train_c = vec_char.fit_transform(X_train)
        train_combined = hstack([train_w, train_c])

        print("Transforming validation data...")
        val_w = vec_word.transform(X_val)
        val_c = vec_char.transform(X_val)
        val_combined = hstack([val_w, val_c])

        print("Transforming test data...")
        test_w = vec_word.transform(test_texts)
        test_c = vec_char.transform(test_texts)
        test_combined = hstack([test_w, test_c])

        print("Training Logistic Regression with balanced class weights...")
        clf = LogisticRegression(
            random_state=42,
            max_iter=1000,
            C=0.5,
            solver="lbfgs",
            n_jobs=-1,
            tol=1e-3,
            class_weight="balanced",
            MultiClass="multinomial",
        )
        clf.fit(train_combined, y_train)

        print("Validating...")
        val_proba = clf.predict_proba(val_combined)
        val_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_proba, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
        val_proba_norm = val_proba_clipped / val_proba_clipped.sum(
            axis=1, keepdims=True
        )
        val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba_norm)
        print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_loss:.6f}")

        print("Generating submission...")
        test_proba = clf.predict_proba(test_combined)
        test_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_proba, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
        test_proba_norm = test_proba_clipped / test_proba_clipped.sum(
            axis=1, keepdims=True
        )

        df_sub = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "id": test_ids,
                "EAP": np.round(test_proba_norm[:, 0], 6),
                "HPL": np.round(test_proba_norm[:, 1], 6),
                "MWS": np.round(test_proba_norm[:, 2], 6),
            }
        )

        df_sub.to_csv(f"{submission_path}submission.csv", index=False)
        print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv successfully.")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
